name: Mousou Kagaku Series Wandaba Style ~Totsugeki! Mix Live Juice~
original_name: 妄想科学シリーズ ワンダバスタイル 〜突撃!みっくす生JUICE〜
source:
The story is about a pop idol band named Mix Juice that need any kind of gig to make their name famous. At the same time, a young boy genius plans on taking a trip to the Moon without using fossil fuels to pollute Earth's atmosphere. Thanks to some clever managing, the girls of Mix Juice and the scientist plan on making their first concert on the Moon by any means necessary.

[from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wandaba_Style]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
这个故事讲述的是一支名为Mix Juice的流行偶像乐队，他们需要任何形式的演出才能让自己的名字出名。与此同时，一位天才小男孩计划在不使用化石燃料污染地球大气层的情况下进行一次月球之旅。多亏了一些巧妙的管理，混合果汁公司的女孩们和科学家计划不择手段地在月球上举办他们的第一场音乐会。

[来自[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wandaba_Style]维基百科[/url]]
